{{For|the building|Roads (Building)|the technology}}

[[File:Road Icon.png|thumb|The road icon.]]

'''Roads''' is a tier two [[technology]]. It unlocks the [[building]] [[Roads (Building)|of the same name]], which increases [[movement]] (see [[Movement#Roads]] for more details) and [[City Connections|connects cities]]. This technology also unlocks the [[bridge]], which functions the same, but on water. Lastly, it also unlocks the Network task, which awards the [[Grand Bazaar]] once five cities are connected to the capital. 

The [[Yădakk]] [[tribe]] starts with Roads.

For [[Cymanti]], Roads unlocks the [[Mycelium]] and the Network task.

== Waterways ==

The [[Aquarion]] tribe has the '''Waterways''' technology instead of Roads. Waterways unlocks the [[Atoll]] and grants the Bubbled ability, that gives units a speed bubble whenever they move onto flooded tiles which increases their movement by 1 until they are attacked or move onto non-flooded land.
